text: 韩国证券存托结算院信息门户（SEIBro）数据显示，2026年前三季度（结算日1月1日至9月30日），韩国投资者净买入金额前15名的港股合计净买入约2.28亿美元，同期净买入前15名A股合计约7987万美元。其中，Global X中国半导体ETF净买入金额高居榜首，前三季度净买入金额为5257万美元。
text_en: Data from the Korea Securities Depository Information Portal (SEIBro) show that in the first three quarters of 2026 (settlement dates from January 1 to September 30), the top 15 Hong Kong stocks by net buying amount by Korean investors had total net buying of about USD 228 million, while the top 15 A-shares by net buying over the same period totaled about USD 79.87 million. Among them, Global X China Semiconductor ETF ranked first by net buying amount, with net buying of USD 52.57 million in the first three quarters.
